extraction.Name: Emily Swallow
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 10, 1925, by Windsor Dougherty
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Windsor Dougherty for $1275.00; on April 6, 1925, Emily Swallow conveyed the land by deed to The Floete Lumber Company for $480.00 subject to the foregoing mortgage
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 759645 issued; Southeast quarter section 8, township 38, range 27; no receipt shown for patent; conveyance dated April 16, 1924
